name: Richelieu Battleship
description: The Richelieu battleship, belonging to France, was transformed into the most advanced and powerful battleship in Europe during World War II. It entered service in 1940. It has a full load displacement of 49,850 tons, a length of 247.8 meters, a speed of 32 knots, and is equipped with two quadruple 380mm main guns, three triple 152mm secondary guns and other weapons. Its combat footprints spanned three oceans. It was the French battleship with the widest war area and the longest voyage mileage. It was also the most famous battleship in the history of the French navy.
